==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I see a man with short blonde hair and round glasses. He is obsessed with probability. He finds genuine happiness from watching dice roll.

He is obnoxious about his interest. Like a sports fan, he reacts loudly to the results of rolls. This attracts a lot of attention.

People grow tired of him. He is pushed out of  probability lectures by his peers. He is left sad and alone.
